title: Individual evidence in a collaborative project
assignment: Twelve groups of four prepare a local environmental-action proposal. generative AI may assist group drafting and visualisation. Each student must independently explain evidence and a project decision.
ai_permissions: Twelve groups of four prepare a local environmental-action proposal. generative AI may assist group drafting and visualisation. Each student must independently explain evidence and a project decision.
budget_scope: Additional checkpoint work; existing product marking excluded

requirements.description: Evaluate a source used in the proposal.
justify a project decision using evidence.
respond to a changed stakeholder constraint. Each student must demonstrate all three; a group-level artefact does not automatically cover individual requirements.

expected_narrative: A costs 51 minutes using N = 12 groups, not 48 students; it has no mandatory individual coverage. B costs 131 minutes, S = 15. D costs 159 minutes, S = 3. Both B and D are non-dominated because B uses less teacher time and D uses less student time. No combination using only A, C, E and F covers E1–E3.
